_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v542_backbone_50k/audits/parity_certificate.json (Oracle §1.5). Forward-migration certificate ONLY — it does NOT prove training comparability and is NOT evidence for E0 reuse (that is the separate a0_reuse_decision record). 6 checkpoints ALL REQUIRED with source_tier/run_updates/checkpoint_update pinned per row (fix-5 C3 + gate-0 A6): run_updates = the source run's total training dose; checkpoint_update = the pinned payload's best-inner-val checkpoint `update` (checkpoint_update <= run_updates; training_updates stays only as an alias equal to run_updates, never the checkpoint update). 3 V541 E0 (S17/S29/S43, MAIN evidence = best inner-val checkpoints from 37,900-update runs/, checkpoint updates 37000/36400/37800, source_tier=v541_e0_runs_final_37900, run_updates=37900) + 3 V53MP C (S17/S29/S43, AUXILIARY evidence = outputs/pesn/v53mp/ S3 formal 20k-tier 15,400-update-run best inner-val checkpoints, checkpoint updates 15400/15300/15400, source_tier=v53mp_20k_s3_formal_15400_auxiliary, run_updates=15400 — NOT 37,900, NOT under runs/, NOT smoke); smoke and non-pinned checkpoints are FORBIDDEN; assets located + SHA-pinned by the read-only lane 2026-10-30 (6/6 required). PASS is decided by CPU bitwise equality; max_abs_diff is recorded but not decisive.

asset_policy.smoke_paths_rejected_note: outputs/pesn/v541_embed_50k/smoke/** 路径 (200-update smoke checkpoint) 永不作为 parity 资产; 资产分层 (fix-5 C3 + gate-0 A6, 取代旧「必须 runs/ 37,900 final」绝对措辞): V541 E0 主证据 = runs/ 下 37,900-update run 的 best inner-val checkpoint (source_tier=v541_e0_runs_final_37900, run_updates=37900, checkpoint_update=37000/36400/37800, training_updates=37900=run_updates 别名); V53MP C 辅助证据 = outputs/pesn/v53mp/ 下 S3 formal 20k-tier 15,400-update run 的 best inner-val checkpoint (source_tier=v53mp_20k_s3_formal_15400_auxiliary, run_updates=15400, checkpoint_update=15400/15300/15400, training_updates=15400=run_updates 别名; 非 37,900、不在 runs/、非 smoke); smoke 与非钉死 (non-pinned) checkpoint 一律禁止

load_audit.rule: strict-audit mapping: read file SHA-256 + payload['model']; apply frozen w_v mapping; missing/unexpected/shape_mismatch/dtype_mismatch ALL empty; assert backbone.w_v.weight is move_decoder.w_v.weight (same tensor); load_state_dict(strict=True); per-key torch.equal(source, target) after load
load_audit.report_schema_note: The machine evidence artifact is the parity harness report schema pes2ts_v542_a0_parity_report_v1 (scripts/agent_ops/v542_a0_parity.py). This template is the signed certificate INSTANCE derived from that report — the report is a strict superset and never silently diverges: source_sha256 <- entries[].load_audit.source_sha256 (actual verified digest), mapping_table_sha256 <- entries[].load_audit.mapping_table_sha256 (LOCAL_PLACEHOLDER: local digest; canonical recipe is advisory A3), target_key_set <- entries[].load_audit.target_key_set (45 mapped target keys), audit_json_path <- entries[].load_audit.audit_json_path (null: the per-asset audit record is embedded in the report JSON itself; see audit_json_path_mapping). The full report additionally carries n_source_keys=43, n_mapped_targets=45, dual_write_aliases, torch_equal_verified count and empty missing/unexpected/shape_mismatch/dtype_mismatch per asset.

real_batch_parity.coverage_note: gate-1 C3: the first eight categories are DETERMINISTICALLY covered by the harness (frozen first-8-chunks inner-val base + first-hit append per missing category; a missing required category is a typed V542_PARITY_COVERAGE failure) with per-category counts+booleans recorded per asset under real_batch_coverage. isolated_atom and zero_in_degree_node are NOT guaranteed by the 50K pool (probe found none in the inner-val slice — molecules are compact under the 4.5 Å spatial cutoff) and are therefore MEASURED and recorded per asset (counts+booleans, may be zero) rather than claimed as covered.
real_batch_parity.rule: same CPU bitwise on real inner-val batches; fixture pass + real-batch fail => data-dependent boundary bug (empty edges, degK=0, key without in-edges) must be diagnosed, never waived

gpu_tolerance.hard_caps_note: atol=1e-6 / rtol=1e-5 是硬上限 (hard caps); 任何 run-to-run 地板规则都不得放宽该容差 (no tolerance relaxation)
gpu_tolerance.legacy_floor_rule: run legacy twice first to measure the run-to-run floor; the floor is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — GPU pass/fail is decided solely by the hard caps (max_abs_diff <= atol AND rel_diff <= rtol); if the measured run-to-run floor exceeds the hard cap => GPU parity is INCONCLUSIVE and cannot count as pass evidence; CPU bitwise equality remains the decisive evidence; tolerances are NEVER relaxed either way

evaluator_parity.rule: load E0 checkpoint into V542 A0; recompute H2/H3 inner-val metrics with the V542 evaluator; require bitwise equality or <=1e-9 vs V541 archived metrics (evaluator is deterministic)
